items.ex_en: Excuse me, could you bring us the check?
Can I see the menu?
items.notes: Invariable plural: i menù. Also spelled menu.

items.ex_en: A bottle of water, please.
items.notes: f.

items.ex_en: I have an espresso after lunch.
items.notes: Un caffè = an espresso by default. Invariable plural: i caffè.

items.ex_en: This wine is very good.
I'd like a small beer.
Is this table free?
The waiter brings the menu.
items.notes: f. la cameriera (waitress).

items.ex_en: I have breakfast at the café.
items.notes: fare colazione = to have breakfast.

items.ex_en: Lunch is at one.
Dinner is at eight.
items.notes: Italians usually eat dinner around 8 p.m. or later.

items.ex: Conosci un buon ristorante qui vicino?
items.ex_en: Do you know a good restaurant near here? (informal)
Shall we get a coffee at the café?
items.notes: An Italian bar serves coffee, pastries and drinks all day.

items.ex_en: The bread is fresh.
Two margherita pizzas, please.
items.notes: Plural: le pizze.

items.ex_en: The pasta is cooked al dente (firm).
items.notes: Una pasta can also mean a pastry.

items.ex: Un cappuccino e un cornetto, per favore.
items.ex_en: A cappuccino and a croissant, please.
items.notes: Italians drink it mainly at breakfast, rarely after a meal.

items.ex: Il cornetto alla crema è buonissimo.
items.ex_en: The cream-filled croissant is delicious.
items.notes: Often called brioche in northern Italy.

items.ex_en: Still water for me, thanks.
items.notes: f.

items.ex_en: Still or sparkling water? — Sparkling.
items.notes: f. Also called acqua gassata.

items.ex_en: I don't eat meat.
The fish is very fresh today.
I'll have the roast chicken.
I eat a lot of vegetables.
items.notes: Singular la verdura is also used collectively.

items.ex_en: For dessert I'll have fruit.
items.notes: Collective singular: fruit in general.

items.ex_en: A mixed salad, please.
items.notes: f.

items.ex_en: This cheese is delicious.
I'll have a chocolate gelato.
What do you have for dessert?
items.notes: Also an adjective: dolce = sweet.

items.ex_en: The cover charge is two euros.
items.notes: Per-person charge for bread and table setting, listed on the menu. Normal, not a scam.

items.ex_en: Should we leave a tip?
items.notes: Tipping isn't expected in Italy; rounding up or a few euros for good service is common.

items.ex: Un bicchiere di vino rosso, per favore.
items.ex_en: A glass of red wine, please.
A bottle of white wine.
I'll have a ham sandwich.
items.notes: Also a bread roll. Plural: i panini.

items.ex_en: This dish is delicious.

items.ex: Il caffè con zucchero o senza?
items.ex_en: Coffee with or without sugar?

items.ex: Un tè con latte, per favore.
items.ex_en: A tea with milk, please.
items.notes: Ordering just un latte gets you a glass of milk.
items.flag: 'Un tè con latte' is understood, but 'un tè al latte' or 'un tè con il latte' is more idiomatic; check which you prefer.

items.ex: Senza prenotazione è difficile trovare posto.
items.ex_en: Without a reservation it's hard to get a table.
As an appetizer we'll have bruschetta.
items.notes: m. Plural: gli antipasti.

items.ex_en: For the first course I'll have lasagna.
items.notes: Pasta, risotto or soup. You don't have to order every course.

items.ex: Come secondo, il pesce del giorno.
items.ex_en: For the main course, the fish of the day.
items.notes: Meat or fish; sides are ordered separately.

items.ex_en: What side dishes do you have?
items.notes: Vegetables or potatoes, ordered separately from the secondo.

items.ex: Il servizio è compreso nel prezzo.
items.ex_en: Service is included in the price.
I'm missing a fork.
This knife doesn't cut.

items.ex: Mi porta un cucchiaio, per favore?
items.ex_en: Could you bring me a spoon, please? (formal)
Can I have a napkin?

items.ex: Mi passi il sale, per favore?
items.ex_en: Can you pass me the salt, please? (informal)
Would you like some pepper? (formal)
items.notes: The vegetable is il peperone.

items.ex_en: Oil and vinegar for the salad.
items.notes: m. l'olio d'oliva = olive oil.

items.ex_en: A hot tea, please.
items.notes: Invariable plural: i tè.

items.ex_en: A fresh orange juice, please.
items.notes: Il succo di frutta = bottled fruit juice.

items.ex: Prosciutto e melone è un antipasto classico.
items.ex_en: Prosciutto and melon is a classic appetizer.
items.notes: Prosciutto crudo = cured ham; prosciutto cotto = cooked ham.

items.ex_en: Spaghetti with tomato sauce, please.
A hamburger with French fries.
items.notes: Le patatine alone can also mean potato chips.

items.ex_en: I eat an egg every morning.
items.notes: m. Irregular plural: le uova (f.).

items.en: espresso with a dash of foamed milk
items.ex_en: A caffè macchiato, please.

items.en: steamed milk with a shot of espresso (like a latte)
items.ex_en: A latte macchiato for me.
I'll have a decaf, thanks.
items.notes: Often shortened to un deca.

items.ex_en: An americano, please.

items.ex: Possiamo vedere la carta dei vini?
items.ex_en: Can we see the wine list?

items.ex: Il vino della casa è buono qui.
items.ex_en: The house wine is good here.
Shall we have an aperitivo at seven?
items.notes: m. Early-evening drink, usually served with snacks.

items.ex_en: Let's eat at a typical trattoria.
Tonight we're going to a pizzeria.

items.ex: Questo salame è un po' piccante.
items.ex_en: This salami is a bit spicy.
Do you have gluten-free pizza?

items.ex: La bistecca alla fiorentina è enorme.
items.ex_en: The Florentine T-bone steak is huge.

items.ex: Il piatto del giorno è il risotto.
items.ex_en: Today's special is risotto.
Can I have some butter?
items.notes: Butter isn't usually served with bread in Italian restaurants.

items.ex: Le lasagne al forno sono buonissime.
items.ex_en: Baked lasagna is delicious.
I'll have the grilled vegetables.

items.ex: Il pesce fritto è ottimo qui.
items.ex_en: The fried fish is excellent here.
items.notes: il fritto misto = mixed fried seafood or vegetables.

items.ex: Gli spaghetti ai frutti di mare sono la specialità.
items.ex_en: Seafood spaghetti is the specialty.

items.en: espresso with a shot of liquor
items.ex: Dopo cena, un caffè corretto alla grappa.
items.ex_en: After dinner, an espresso with a shot of grappa.

items.ex: Vorrei un bicchiere di vino rosso.
items.ex_en: I'd like a glass of red wine.
items.notes: Polite form of volere; the standard way to order.

items.ex_en: Excuse me! The check, please.
items.notes: The waiter won't bring the check until you ask.

items.ex_en: The spaghetti for me, thanks.
Can I have another glass?
I'll have the margherita pizza.

items.it: Un tavolo per due, per favore.
items.ex: Buonasera, un tavolo per due, per favore. — Prego, da questa parte.
items.ex_en: Good evening, a table for two, please. — This way, please.

items.en: Do you have a free table?
items.ex: Avete un tavolo libero per stasera?
items.ex_en: Do you have a free table for tonight?
How many of you are there? — There are four of us.

items.en: I'd like to book a table.
items.ex: Vorrei prenotare un tavolo per quattro alle otto.
items.ex_en: I'd like to book a table for four at eight.

items.en: I have a reservation under the name…
items.ex: Buonasera, ho una prenotazione a nome Smith.
items.ex_en: Good evening, I have a reservation under the name Smith.

items.ex: Sono vegetariano: non mangio carne né pesce.
items.ex_en: I'm vegetarian: I don't eat meat or fish.
items.notes: f. Sono vegetariana.

items.ex: Che cosa mi consiglia come secondo?
items.ex_en: What do you recommend for the main course?

items.en: Do you have a menu in English?
items.ex: Scusi, avete un menù in inglese? — Sì, eccolo.
items.ex_en: Excuse me, do you have a menu in English? — Yes, here it is.

items.ex: Prendo un caffè al banco e vado.
items.ex_en: I'll have an espresso at the counter and go.
items.notes: Standing at the counter is cheaper than table service.

items.ex: E da bere? — Una bottiglia di acqua naturale.
items.ex_en: And to drink? — A bottle of still water.
Have you decided? — Yes, we're ready.

items.ex: Ci porta un po' di pane, per favore?
items.ex_en: Could you bring us some bread, please?
Another beer, please.
items.notes: un altro (m.), un'altra (f.).

items.ex: Scusi, è incluso il servizio? — Sì, è nel conto.
items.ex_en: Excuse me, is service included? — Yes, it's in the check.

items.ex: Ecco la pasta. Buon appetito! — Grazie!
items.ex_en: Here's the pasta. Enjoy your meal! — Thanks!
I'm hungry! Shall we go eat?
items.notes: Literally 'I have hunger'.

items.ex_en: I'm thirsty, I'll get a water.

items.ex: La pizza senza funghi, per favore.
items.ex_en: The pizza without mushrooms, please.

items.ex: Ho un'allergia alimentare: niente arachidi, per favore.
items.ex_en: I have a food allergy: no peanuts, please.
Does it contain gluten? — Yes, unfortunately.

items.en: I have celiac disease (I can't eat gluten).
items.ex: Sono celiaco: avete la pasta senza glutine?
items.ex_en: I have celiac disease: do you have gluten-free pasta?
items.notes: f. Sono celiaca. Gluten-free options are common in Italy.

items.ex: Sono vegano: niente carne, latte o uova.
items.ex_en: I'm vegan: no meat, milk or eggs.
items.notes: f. Sono vegana.

items.ex: Questo piatto è piccante? — Un po'.
items.ex_en: Is this dish spicy? — A little.

items.it: Che cosa c'è in questo piatto?
items.ex: Che cosa c'è in questo piatto? — Pomodoro e melanzane.
items.ex_en: What's in this dish? — Tomato and eggplant.

items.ex: Avete deciso? — Ancora un attimo, per favore.
items.ex_en: Have you decided? — Just one more moment, please.
How was it? — Everything was delicious, thanks!
To our health! Cheers!
items.notes: Also: Salute!

items.en: That's all, thanks. / That's enough, thanks.
items.ex_en: Anything else? — No, that's all, thanks.
Can we pay separately? — Of course.

items.en: Do you pay at the register?
items.ex: Si paga alla cassa o al tavolo?
items.ex_en: Do you pay at the register or at the table?
items.notes: In many bars you pay first at the cassa, then order at the counter with the receipt.

items.ex: Due pizze margherita da portare via.
items.ex_en: Two margherita pizzas to go.
items.notes: Also: da asporto.

items.ex: Possiamo sederci fuori? — Sì, c'è un tavolo libero.
items.ex_en: Can we sit outside? — Yes, there's a free table.

items.it: Un quarto di vino della casa
items.en: a quarter liter of house wine
items.ex: Per noi un quarto di vino rosso della casa.
items.ex_en: A quarter liter of red house wine for us.
items.notes: House wine is often sold by the carafe: un quarto, mezzo litro, un litro.

items.ex_en: No more, thanks, I'm full!
items.notes: f. Sono piena.

items.ex_en: Excuse me, I didn't order this.

items.it: A che ora chiude la cucina?
items.en: What time does the kitchen close?
items.ex: A che ora chiude la cucina? — Alle undici.
items.ex_en: What time does the kitchen close? — At eleven.
